Author: Valenth Siveria
Name: BlackJack Buttler
Punchline: Good evening. I'm your BlackJack Buttler - quietly tracking the table and offering the right hint at the right time.
Changelog:
v1.5.4.1:
- New: Emergency Stop (X) button — abort a running player action mid-execution, restore game state to before the action, and disable Auto Run
- Enhancement: CommandExecutor delays are now cancellable via CancellationToken for instant abort response
- Fix: Race condition guard in DiceResultHandler prevents card application after cancel
